newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds follow higher Chicago close.
newsitem.headline: European feeds follow higher Chicago close.

text.p: Sellers on the European meals and feeds market followed Friday's higher Chicago soymeal futures close and offered South American soymeal $3 to $7 up, but buying interest was scarce this morning, dealers said.
Most other products were quoted $1 to $2 up in sympathy with soymeal and a slightly easier dollar.
One early trade was reported at $112 a tonne cif Rotterrdam for March citruspulp pellets.
"The dollar is a bit lower but still strong. That and the higher seller prices were still a high hurdle for buyers to take this morning," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
